_doc: H12 Patrón: the baker's Panadería (04d 4.22.4.3): the oven bakes bread (and meat pies with its third Production upgrade); the counter sells to the passers-by with Commerce 1 (D16). 3x4 with housing, on a production plot (the patron's other trades: data/starts patron_<trade>, raised on the player forge's plot). upkeep 12 [balance]. Its employees may start at dawn (the schedule's work_phases already open at dawn: the «turno del alba» of 4.22.4.3).
